protocol: model fit once on all BUS-BRA patients; no TCIA tuning or calibration
claim_boundary: expert tumor masks are required; this validates breast lesion malignancy only, not kidney etiology

model: frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 whole-image embeddings + patient-weighted balanced L2 logistic regression
split: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by case; mean probability across each case's images

selection: epoch selected in an inner patient split; all metrics from untouched outer patients

sampling: label-blind evenly spaced images within each sorted patient sequence
evaluation: nested 5 outer x 4 inner patient-level stratified CV; inner selects logistic C
claim_boundary: development pilot only; Batch 2 remains locked and was not loaded
